description: This file contains Perl code that generates assembly routines for AES-GCM encryption and decryption optimized with AES-NI instructions, including functions for CTR mode and GHASH, with platform-specific handling for Windows and Linux. It includes detailed assembly implementations for cryptographic primitives, performance optimizations, and licensing information.

methods.name: aesni_gcm_encrypt
methods.description: Assembly routine for AES-GCM encryption using AES-NI, handling input processing, key expansion, and GHASH calculation with platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: aesni_gcm_decrypt
methods.description: Assembly routine for AES-GCM decryption using AES-NI, similar structure to encryption, with input validation and GHASH processing.
